name: deltas_all
mod: process.hgcalLayerClustersEE.plugin.deltas = [VALUE, VALUE, VALUE, VALUE]; process.hgcalLayerClustersHSi.plugin.deltas = [VALUE, VALUE, VALUE, VALUE]; process.hgcalLayerClustersHSci.plugin.deltas = [VALUE/1.3*0.0315, VALUE/1.3*0.0315, VALUE/1.3*0.0315, VALUE/1.3*0.0315]
info: Seed-promotion distance (delta_c) in all parts together (EE, HSi, HSci; HFNose ignored). VALUE is applied directly in silicon units (EE, HSi); HSci is rescaled by its default ratio to silicon (0.0315/1.3). Default value is 1.3 (0.0315 for HSci).
